What would more spending buy?

Hold acquisition efficiency constant and inspect the implications. These outputs illustrate additional monthly activity; they do not forecast earnings or establish ROI.

0% · current spend30% more

Read the assumptions and limits

Additional spend = baseline spend × uplift. Additional verified customers = extra spend ÷ baseline CAC. Additional activated customers = extra verified × baseline activation rate. Inputs use the selected month and customer origin.

The illustration assumes unchanged CAC and activation. It omits saturation, time to activation, retention, capacity, fraud, lifetime value and intervention costs. It cannot determine the financial return from improving the product or predict quarterly results.
